root.statement: Build and privately verify an authorized Discord voice control plane while preserving guild authority, privacy, and explicit live-deployment gates.
root.source_state: A public seed repository exists without implementation and live Discord and Cloudflare credentials are not available to source code.
root.target_state: A tested and published private-control relay implementation exists with an encrypted local approval queue and manual final send; protected live proof remains separate and Socialize remains externally blocked.
conditions: Keep live Discord credentials out of the repository.
Use only official-bot APIs or Discord-approved local RPC; do not use raw user tokens, user Gateway sessions, UI keystrokes, automatic user-message sending, or synthetic activity.
Do not touch the dirty SOL Tools checkout.
root.boundary: The repository, the user's authorized private Discord applications and test guild, the selected personal Cloudflare account, and a future explicitly approved Socialize test window.

intent.summary: Ship a reusable control plane where the private Voice Rooms bot queues requests, a separately authorized local-RPC account supplies target presence, and the owner performs the final paste and send.
intent.unknown_disposition: The user owns subjective acceptance and Socialize staff owns target-guild authorization.

decision.summary: Implement local and deployment-ready surfaces before credential-gated external actions.
decision.unknown_disposition: Reopen the host decision if the Cloudflare UDP, DAVE, or lifecycle proof fails.

acceptance_contract.summary: Pass static, unit, integration, private-guild, DAVE, UDP, lifecycle, security, and evidence gates without unsupported claims.
acceptance_contract.unknown_disposition: Private-guild and target-guild runtime acceptance remain open until credentials and approved windows exist.

mechanism.summary: Cloudflare interactions and Durable Object coordination drive either the official bot agent or a separate profile-bound Windows agent using Discord's documented local RPC.
mechanism.unknown_disposition: Container UDP, DAVE, and lifecycle behavior require live proof.

current_state_history.summary: The official-bot implementation remains reusable. Local main now adds a bounded RPC adapter, exact profile/user/guild/target binding, relay-only private intake, authenticated ingress, an encrypted local approval queue, and manual preparation; publication and all protected live behavior remain unverified.
current_state_history.unknown_disposition: Recheck branch, HEAD, credentials, and live app state before external actions.

people_incentives.summary: The user owns the repository and local profile; Discord owns RPC partner/tester access; Socialize staff owns the approved target window and retention policy; guild members are affected non-users.
people_incentives.unknown_disposition: Do not treat the user's implementation authority as authority over another guild's retention policy.

lifecycle_recovery.summary: Use circuit breakers, version rollback, compensating D1 migrations, token rotation, app removal, and a conventional-host adapter if Cloudflare proof fails.
lifecycle_recovery.unknown_disposition: Live rollback and target removal remain unverified until deployment.

invariants.statement: Do not exceed explicit Discord guild authority, expose credentials, use undocumented user-account surfaces, synthesize retention activity, or modify the protected SOL Tools root.

authority.scope: Build, test, and publish to main the private relay-only bot intake, authenticated Cloudflare ingress, encrypted local queue/dashboard, and documented local-RPC preparation path. Voice Rooms remains private-control-only; credentials, OAuth/permission confirmations, privileged-intent changes, deployment, and target permissions remain human-reserved. Workers Paid was observed active, while Socialize remains untouched.
authority.decision_owner: Repository owner for implementation; target-guild staff for Socialize actions
authorized_actions: Create and modify the isolated repository.
Create the public GitHub repository, retain review history, publish verified commits to main, and delete the redundant task branch after exact ref checks.
Deploy to the selected Cloudflare account after the user enables the required paid plan.
Perform ordinary already-authenticated Discord UI navigation and inspection while respecting confirmation gates.
Implement Discord's documented local RPC IPC and OAuth path with exact profile, user, guild, and target binding.
forbidden_actions: Use a raw Discord user token, open a user Gateway, drive Discord UI keystrokes, or automatically send a Discord message as a user.
Generate synthetic activity or bypass inactivity policy.
Expose secrets or change billing, security prompts, or target permissions for the user.
Delete a branch that has not been proved redundant with main or is unrelated to this task.
Solve or bypass CAPTCHA, display or copy credentials through automation, or change in-app security, privacy, privileged-intent, or permission settings.
human_reserved_decisions: Discord CAPTCHA, credential creation or revelation, privileged-intent changes, bot permission confirmation, local RPC OAuth confirmation, and Socialize target approval.

hard_gates.rationale: The user authorized repository creation, implementation, publication, and their own deployment; named human gates remain reserved.

The design rejects raw user tokens, user Gateway sessions, Discord UI keystrokes, automatic user-message sending, synthetic activity, and voice collection; local mode stays on documented OAuth-authorized RPC.
Least privilege, signature validation, redaction, no voice collection, and secret isolation are acceptance invariants.
GitHub publication on main and Cloudflare deployment are authorized; credentials, target permissions, and unrelated branch deletion remain gated. Workers Paid enrollment is complete.
Deployment is in scope after private evidence and the remaining credential handoffs; the paid-plan gate is complete and destructive cleanup is not authorized.
CAPTCHA, credential exposure, privileged intents, permissions, Socialize approval, and subjective acceptance have named human owners. The billing decision was completed by the owner.
Worker and container versions can roll back; D1 changes require compensating migration or point-in-time recovery and leave audit residue.

tests.question: Can an exact configured target approver authorize the stored voice target without inheriting managed-room administration?
tests.changes_decision_if: A failure would block command registration and require redesigning the target-authorization surface before live setup.

tests.question: Does the shared command contract reject a validly shaped envelope whose lifetime exceeds the authorized 30-second window?
tests.changes_decision_if: A failure would block deployment because a producer other than the current Worker could issue an overlong signed command that the shared verifier accepts.

bounds.stop_rule: Expand only branches that can change action, acceptance, mitigation, monitoring, rollback, residual risk, or a human decision.

nodes.statement: Implement and test the local system while preserving live-deployment and authority gates.
Removing the blanket Discord command permission makes the runtime subcommand checks load-bearing for every voice administration invocation.
Shared schema rejection makes the 30-second constant load-bearing for every command producer and fixture.

edges.source_delta: The blanket default member permission is removed from the shared voice administration command.
edges.mechanism: Discord no longer preempts an exact user allowlist, while the bot parses a fixed subcommand and requires Manage Channels or the narrower exact target-approver rule before mutation.
conditions: The registered command definition matches the tested source.
The interaction reaches the official Voice Rooms bot in a guild.
edges.lag: At command registration and each subsequent invocation.
edges.target_delta: Allowlisted target approvers can reach authorize-target, and unauthorized or underprivileged callers are rejected by the runtime gate.

detection.signal: Command-definition, gate-mapping, exact-allowlist, and full-suite tests remain green; live denied invocations are still required in VC Control Lab.
detection.latency: Immediate in local tests and one interaction response in the private guild.
detection.failure_to_detect: A future handler bypass could expose an administration mutation despite the command definition remaining unchanged.

edges.falsifier: An unauthorized member completes any voice administration mutation, or an exact configured target approver is rejected solely for lacking Manage Channels.

confidence.basis: Current source and focused tests directly exercise the command definition, subcommand mapping, and exact service allowlist.

edges.source_delta: The shared envelope contract now rejects issue-to-expiry intervals longer than 30 seconds.
edges.mechanism: All parsers apply the same super-refinement, while the control Worker and shared fixture import the same lifetime constant.
conditions: Consumers parse command envelopes through the shared contract.
The deployed control Worker matches the verified source.
edges.lag: At command creation and at each subsequent envelope parse.
edges.target_delta: A validly signed command cannot extend its authorized issue-to-expiry window beyond 30 seconds through schema-valid input.

detection.signal: The 30,001-millisecond boundary test and complete package suite remain green.
detection.latency: Immediate in local tests and at the first parser invocation in a deployed runtime.
detection.failure_to_detect: A consumer that bypasses the shared parser would not inherit this bound.

edges.falsifier: A validly signed envelope with a lifetime longer than 30 seconds parses successfully or is accepted by an agent command path.

confidence.basis: The shared parser, production command producer, fixture, and focused boundary test use the same exported constant.

closure.summary: The private relay intake, authenticated ingress, encrypted local queue/dashboard, RPC preparation, profile isolation, and manual final-send boundary are locally tested.
